chapters.label: Wembley, live
chapters.text: Wembley, 2025, the League Cup final. Newcastle lead Liverpool one-nil. Tino Livramento hangs up a high cross. Jacob Murphy wins the header... Alexander Isak! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Murphy beats Andy Robertson in the air and heads it down into the box. Isak is already there, calm and ready.

chapters.label: The half-volley
chapters.text: Relaxed, he lets it bounce once, then sweeps a half-volley low past Kelleher, into the corner. Newcastle lead two-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! Stay relaxed on the ball. Soft, calm touches keep it under your control.
